test_description: Verify that cosmetic TASK.md edits (comments, trailing whitespace) do not change the fingerprint
test_assertions: Fingerprint is identical when only comments differ between TASK.md files
Fingerprint is identical when only trailing whitespace differs
Fingerprint is identical whether sourced from file path or normalized taskDef fields
change_description: Make computeFingerprint use hashTaskFrontmatter + hashTaskBody + hashTaskChecks from hash/task.ts instead of hashing raw file content, so cosmetic TASK.md changes don't cause false cache invalidation
why_this_correction: Evidence from observe phase (helpers.ts line 77): readFileSync reads raw TASK.md file verbatim, bypassing hashTaskBody (which strips trailing whitespace) and hashTaskFrontmatter (which uses sorted keys via stableStringify). Fixing fingerprint to hash normalized fields prevents an entire class of false cache invalidation bugs caused by cosmetic TASK.md changes. This is a correctness/prevention/determinism finding — the framework produces different results for semantically identical tasks.
